title: Ticket routing and draft approval
objective: Suggest a category for a redacted request; create a test ticket only after approval.
data: Test messages, stable event IDs and least-privilege test credentials.
output: Category, draft, approval, destination record ID and receipt.
acceptance: Replay an event without duplicate tickets; reconcile a lost response; rejected approval creates nothing.
recovery: Query the destination after timeout; escalate unknown outcomes; allow at most two conditional retries.
excluded: No production ticket system or automatic emails.

steps.name: Create test ticket and retain receipt
